snippet.title: Mega Man: Dual Override Jet Man Reveal Trailer | TGS 2026
snippet.description:
Watch the Mega Man: Dual Override Jet Man Reveal Trailer from TGS 2026, introducing Jet Man, one of the new Robot Masters Mega Man and Proto Man will face in Capcom’s latest mainline Mega Man adventure.

Tokyo Game Show 2026 is here! Catch all the biggest game reveals, trailers, gameplay, demos, announcements, and surprises from TGS 2026.

Watch all of our TGS 2026 coverage here:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLPZoHW-xRvGo

Mega Man: Dual Override brings Mega Man back alongside Proto Man as a second playable hero, with each offering a distinct approach to combat. Players can equip more than 50 Custom Chips to modify their abilities and builds, while the new Override system lets both heroes temporarily push beyond their normal limits for a massive boost in power at the cost of becoming vulnerable afterward.

The latest mainline entry features a new lineup of eight Robot Masters, including Jet Man and the previously revealed Twinkle Girl, with defeating Robot Masters once again granting powerful Special Weapons. Mega Man: Dual Override launches in Spring 2027 for PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, and PC.
